thread.title: Apple Down Nearly 7%, on Pace for Largest Percent Decrease Since January 2014 -- Data Talk

author: www.4-traders.com
title: Apple Down Nearly 7%, on Pace for Largest Percent Decrease Since January 2014 -- Data Talk
text:
Apple Inc. (AAPL) is currently at $206.82, down $15.40 or 6.93%
-- Would be lowest close since Aug. 1, 2018 when it closed at $201.50
-- On pace for largest percent decrease since Jan. 28, 2014 when it fell 7.99%
-- On Thursday, Apple's forecast of revenue between $89 billion and $93 billion for the holiday quarter didn't portend explosive growth, with the low end of its range only slightly above the year-ago results. The company said it would stop reporting unit-sales figures for its three most recognizable brands, the iPhone, iPad and Mac, while giving more details on its services business.
-- Apple's stock fell 6% to around $209 a share at Friday's open on Wall Street, a drop that threatens to return Apple from its lofty trillion-dollar stock-market valuation back into the orbit of its tech-giant peers
-- Snaps a three day winning streak
-- Down 10.88% from its all-time closing high of $232.07 on Oct. 3, 2018
-- Traded as low as $206.60
-- Down 7.03% at today's intraday low; largest intraday percent decrease since April 27, 2016 when it fell as much as 8.31%
-- Worst performer in the DJIA today
-- Fourth worst performer in the S&P 500 today
-- Third most active stock in the S&P 500 today
-- Second worst performer in the Nasdaq 100 today
-- Most active stock in the Nasdaq 100 today
-- Subtracted 104.42 points from the DJIA so far today
All data as of 10:54:45 AM
Source: Dow Jones Market Data, FactSet
